structured_output.position: The baseline of 50.6% already blends a 52% market with a 45% standings estimate, and the market has had the roster news for a day or more. The Liquipedia page shows apEX in for jL on Vitality, edited 2026-11-23, about 8 hours before the 04:00Z start on 11-24. That is public and almost certainly priced into the 52%. The standings snapshot is from 2026-11-02 and predates the swap, so its 45% is the stale input. The dossier gives no evidence on form, travel or illness, and MOUZ is unchanged. I concede a small stand-in discount for Vitality and nothing more.

claims.claim: Vitality use apEX as a stand-in for the benched jL. This is public on Liquipedia and was posted before the match, so bookmakers have very likely priced it in. Any residual effect is small.

The standings roster dates from 2026-11-02 and still lists jL. The 20% standings weight therefore rates a Vitality lineup that no longer plays. That is a stale input, and the market has already corrected for it.
MOUZ have an unchanged five-man roster and coach, with Nikodeon unused. There is no MOUZ-side disruption to adjust for.
